Reference path tracer — ground-truth comparator; no specific paper cited, but serves as the A/B target for radiance-cache quality assessments. The PT_HASH_GRID_CACHE_ENABLED-gated cache writes at secondary+ vertices port Capsaicin GI-1.0 hash_grid_cache.hlsl secondary-vertex pattern; the cache read at bounce>=1 ports Capsaicin's Site-3 (TraceReflectionsHandleHit, gi1.comp:2865-2900) read-only-replace-shading shape into our loop-per-bounce raygen. The secondary-bounce write — BRDF/pdf-modulated next-cell mean folded back into the previous vertex's slot — ports Capsaicin's UpdateMultibounceCells (gi1.comp:1962-1975) cell-to-cell feedback into the same loop-per-bounce shape (D1 collapses Capsaicin's separate UpdateCellValueIndirectBuffer onto the single direct buffer). Full audit at .alignments/TASK-77.1-rework-paper-port-audit.md.

entries.paper: GI-1.0 §2.2 (World Cache) — open-addressing spatial hash with secondary-vertex outgoing-radiance storage. Direction-keyed (Capsaicin uses incoming-ray direction quantized to 5×5×5 buckets, NOT surface normal — D3 in the audit).
entries.notes: Per-axis pcgHash / xxHash32 chain by addition (Capsaicin sources from math/pack.hlsl, not fetched in audit; bodies inlined here are standard PCG and xxHash32). D1: kernel-per-bounce vs. loop-per-bounce — only the Site-3 read pattern fits, no UpdateMultibounceCells port. D2: capacity halved (NUM_BUCKETS_LOG2=13 vs. Capsaicin default 14). PackRadiance / UnpackRadiance use 4× f32tof16 / f16tof32 to mirror Capsaicin's packHalf4 / unpackHalf4 (math/pack.hlsl, not fetched). Full divergence list at .alignments/TASK-77.1-rework-paper-port-audit.md.

entries.paper: GI-1.0 §2.2 (World Cache) — running-mean update of the persistent ValueBuffer from the per-frame atomic-sum scratch. Direct lobe at gi1.comp:2160-2180 (unconditional) and indirect lobe at gi1.comp:2183-2223 (`if (USE_MULTI_BOUNCE)` twin).
entries.notes: Ports the MIP-0 block of Capsaicin UpdateTiles (gi1.comp:2160-2180 direct; gi1.comp:2183-2223 indirect — the `USE_MULTI_BOUNCE` twin restored at D1-reversal CL B). The mip 1-3 box-filter cascade lives in PTHashGridCacheMipCascadeBuild.comp. Direct lobe caps at `cb.max_sample_count` (Capsaicin gi1.h:63 default 16); indirect lobe caps at `MAX_MULTIBOUNCE_SAMPLE_COUNT` (Capsaicin gi1.h:65 default 16) — Capsaicin holds the two caps as independent knobs because direct vs indirect contributions arrive at different cadences. Wide non-indirect dispatch over every tile slot replaces Capsaicin's UpdateTileBuffer / IndirectDispatch dirty-tile tracking — the early-out on HashBuffer == 0 keeps unclaimed tiles cheap. PurgeTiles (PTHashGridCachePurgeTiles.comp) ordered before this pass each frame so freed slots produce HashBuffer == 0 and skip the running-mean merge.

entries.paper: GI-1.0 §2.2 (World Cache) — tile decay / LRU eviction. Slots whose DecayTileBuffer marker has fallen more than 50 frames behind the current frame counter are freed by zeroing HashBuffer[tile_index].
entries.notes: Ports Capsaicin PurgeTiles (gi1.comp:1715-1752) and the kHashGridCache_TileDecay constant (hash_grid_cache.hlsl:29 == 50). Wide non-indirect dispatch over every tile slot, one group per tile (64 threads, only thread 0 acts) — Capsaicin's PackedTileIndexBuffer re-pack is deliberately not ported because the engine does not run an indirect-dispatch UpdateTiles. Per-cell ValueBuffer / UpdateCellValueBuffer slots of a freed tile are intentionally NOT zeroed (paper-faithful — Capsaicin lets the running-mean smooth out slot-reclaim leaks within ~16 frames). Schedule: ordered before UpdateTiles and the path tracer on the Compute queue each frame. Minor divergence: our PurgeTiles also zeros DecayTileBuffer[tile_index] for defensive symmetry with the scene-load clear, while Capsaicin zeros only HashBuffer[tile_index] — the extra zero is harmless because the next InsertCell re-bumps the marker the same frame.

entries.paper: GI-1.0 §2.2 (World Cache) — per-tile mip-cascade aggregation. mip-(L+1) cells are the 4-way sum of their mip-L children in `radiance × sample_count` storage; recovering the per-sample mean at read time yields a sample-count-weighted average of the children, matching a fatter footprint. Direct lobe at gi1.comp:2227-2347 and indirect lobe at gi1.comp:2252-2345 (the `USE_MULTI_BOUNCE` twin running side-by-side with the direct cascade in the same fused thread group).
entries.notes: Ports Capsaicin's mip 1/2/3 blocks of UpdateTiles (gi1.comp:2227-2347 direct; gi1.comp:2252-2345 indirect — the `USE_MULTI_BOUNCE` twin restored at D1-reversal CL B with its own LDS array `lds_UpdateTiles_ValueIndirectBuffer[8][8]`) plus the cell-index-by-mip helper (hash_grid_cache.hlsl:207-221). Aggregation rule, stride-doubling LDS box filter, and packed `radiance × sample_count` storage convention are paper-faithful. Pipeline divergence: Capsaicin fuses the cascade into UpdateTiles with a 2D 8x8 thread group; we run a separate pass with one tile per group (64 threads, 1D layout) so PTHashGridCacheUpdateTiles can stay a focused mip-0 resolve. Schedule: PurgeTiles → UpdateTiles → MipCascadeBuild → PathTracer on the Compute queue, same Signal/Wait pattern as siblings. CL-B note: direct cascade contents are written but unread (Site-3 read at GPUPathTracerRayGen still uses mip 0); indirect cascade contents are also written but the mip-0 source is itself zero (no indirect scratch writer until CL C) so the indirect cascade is double-dead this CL — runtime no-op, structural delta only.

entries.paper: Troy Sobotka — AgX (display rendering transform). Sigmoid contrast curve in log-encoded display-referred space; replaces ACES Filmic tonemapping.
entries.reference: https://github.com/sobotka/AgX (canonical) + https://github.com/google/filament/blob/main/filament/src/ToneMapper.cpp (Filament's polynomial-fit port) + https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js/blob/dev/src/renderers/shaders/ShaderChunk/tonemapping_pars_fragment.glsl.js (Three.js port the engine implementation follows)
entries.notes: Polynomial-fit AgX-Default — single-pass, no LUT. Matrices and EV bounds are named constants in the file; sigmoid is the AgXDefaultContrastApprox polynomial.
